era: 1707-1783 : 瑞士（生于巴塞尔牧师之家—师从约翰·伯努利—1727 年赴圣彼得堡科学院—1735 年右眼几乎失明仍一年内连解巴塞尔问题与七桥问题—1741 年应腓特烈二世之召主持柏林科学院数学部—1748《无穷分析引论》确立 e/f(x)/sin 等记号体系—1755 理想流体欧拉方程—1766 年返圣彼得堡同年双目全盲—1771 年住宅焚毁于大火仍凭记忆重写手稿—1772 失明中完成月球运动理论—1783 年 9 月 18 日推演天王星轨道时卒于圣彼得堡）
era_en: 1707-1783 : Switzerland (born to a pastor's family in Basel - studied under Johann Bernoulli - to the St. Petersburg Academy in 1727 - nearly lost his right eye by 1735 yet that same year solved both the Basel problem and the Konigsberg bridges - called by Frederick II in 1741 to lead mathematics at the Berlin Academy - the Introductio in analysin infinitorum of 1748 fixing the notation system of e, f(x), sin - the Euler equations for ideal fluids in 1755 - returned to St. Petersburg in 1766 and went totally blind that year - his house burned in the 1771 fire, manuscripts rewritten from memory - the lunar theory completed in blindness, 1772 - died in St. Petersburg on 18 September 1783 while deriving the orbit of Uranus)
school: 圣彼得堡-柏林科学院学派 / 分析学记号体系的立法者 / 解析数论开创者 / 理性力学分析化 / 图论与拓扑学的共同始祖
historical_significance: 欧拉（1707-1783），瑞士数学家与物理学家，史上最多产的数学家：全集超过 80 卷，占其时代数学出版物的约三分之一，死后圣彼得堡科学院仍刊行其手稿近半个世纪。《无穷分析引论》(1748) 把分析学铸成以函数为中心的体系，并立法了现代数学的记号：e、π 的标准化、i、f(x)、sin/cos、Σ；欧拉恒等式 e^{iπ}+1=0 被誉为最美公式。他解巴塞尔问题（ζ(2)=π²/6）开创解析数论，一篇七桥短文使图论与拓扑学同时受洗，理想流体欧拉方程 (1755) 使流体力学获得系统方程组，最小作用量原理把光学、力学、流体收编为同一框架。他双目失明后完成毕生约一半著作，1771 年大火焚毁手稿后凭记忆重写。他的方法论——富产先于完婚、形式运算先行、问题定义创造、双域桥接、失明心算、符号立法、机构产能管线、计算实验、统一原理收编、逆境降速不断线——构成一个以『让推演自己走完』为核心的完整思想体系。
historical_significance_en: Leonhard Euler (1707-1783), Swiss mathematician and physicist, the most prolific mathematician in history: the Opera Omnia exceeds 80 volumes, roughly a third of the mathematical output of his era, and the St. Petersburg Academy kept printing his manuscripts for nearly half a century after his death. The Introductio in analysin infinitorum (1748) cast analysis into a function-centered system and legislated the notation of modern mathematics: e, the standardization of π, i, f(x), sin/cos, Σ; Euler's identity e^{iπ}+1=0 is celebrated as the most beautiful formula. Solving the Basel problem (ζ(2)=π²/6) he founded analytic number theory; a single paper on the Konigsberg bridges baptized graph theory and topology together; the Euler equations for ideal fluids (1755) gave fluid mechanics its systematic equation set; the least-action principle annexed optics, mechanics, and fluids into one framework. About half his life's work was completed after total blindness, and after the 1771 fire he rewrote burned manuscripts from memory. His methodology—abundance before polish, formal manipulation first, problem-definition creation, cross-domain bridging, blind calculation, notation legislation, institutional production line, calculation as experiment, unifying-principle annexation, and throttle-down-never-off under adversity—forms a complete system with 'let the derivation finish itself' at its core.
unique_thinking: 他的方法是把一切障碍改造成推演的燃料：外部分析工具被剥夺时他把工作记忆变成完整的公式库（失明后产量反而占毕生一半）；严格性尚未到位时他先信任符号运算，让发散级数把他带到正确答案，再等两百年后的合法化追认；个人手速有上限时他把天赋改造成两所科学院、通信网络、教科书与学徒的机构管线。他的记号不是记录而是生产——f(x) 让函数成为一等公民，i 让不可能参与代数，于是公式自己会说话：e^{iπ}+1=0 不是他找到的，是五件记号家具在同一房间里自然相会的。
unique_thinking_en: His method turned every obstacle into fuel for derivation: when external analytic tools were taken away he converted working memory into a complete formula library (post-blindness output still half of his life's work); before rigor caught up he trusted formal manipulation, letting divergent series carry him to correct answers to await ratification two centuries later; when one man's hand speed capped out he rebuilt talent into an institutional pipeline of two academies, a correspondence network, textbooks, and apprentices. His notation records nothing and manufactures everything—f(x) makes function a first-class citizen, i lets the impossible join algebra, and so formulas speak for themselves: e^{iπ}+1=0 was not found by him; it is five pieces of notational furniture meeting naturally in one room.

name_zh: 方法论/以海量产出优先于单件完美
name_en: 方法论/以海量产出优先于单件完美
category: 方法论/以海量产出优先于单件完美
modes.domain_zh: 先让结论大量涌现，再让润色跟上——产出的数量本身是发现质量的来源
modes.domain_en: Let conclusions pour forth first and polish catch up later—the sheer volume of output is itself a source of discovery quality
modes.definition_zh: 欧拉一生写出约 850 篇论著，超过任何时代的任何数学家；圣彼得堡科学院的档案显示，他死后仍持续『出版』长达半个世纪——印刷机跟不上他手稿的速度。他给出的结果常以『够用即发布』的状态面世：证明有缺口、推广未完成、常数未算精，但他深知草稿进入世界后会获得反馈、同行会接手补全。这与高斯的 pauca sed matura 恰成两极：高斯冻结河流只给冰，欧拉放任河流任其奔涌。深意在于：探索与发布是两种不同的函数——探索的产出率取决于尝试次数，发布的质量取决于迭代次数，而尝试次数对迭代次数有放大作用；先追求数量，质量的收敛反而更快。代价：遗留大量『欧拉式不严谨』，让后世数学家花两百年给他的结论补严格化（分析学的基础直到柯西-魏尔斯特拉斯才补齐）。现代对应物：软件的『快速发布、持续迭代』、精益创业的 MVP、论文预印本文化——先让想法获得世界，再让世界磨平想法。
modes.definition_en: Euler wrote roughly 850 works in his life, more than any mathematician of any era; the archives of the St. Petersburg Academy show that he kept 'publishing' for half a century after his death—the printing presses could not keep up with his manuscripts. His results often appeared in a state of 'good enough to release': proofs with gaps, extensions unfinished, constants not computed to precision. He understood that once a draft enters the world it receives feedback and colleagues will take over its completion. This is the polar opposite of Gauss's pauca sed matura: where Gauss froze the river and handed over ice, Euler let the river run. The deeper point: exploration and publication are different functions—the rate of exploration depends on the number of attempts, the quality of publication on the number of iterations, and the number of attempts amplifies the iterations; chase volume first and quality converges faster. The cost: a large residue of 'Eulerian looseness' that took later mathematicians two hundred years to rigorize (the foundations of analysis were not repaired until Cauchy and Weierstrass). Modern analogues: rapid release and continuous iteration in software, the MVP of lean startups, preprint culture—let the idea reach the world first, then let the world sand the idea smooth.
modes.source_chapter: 圣彼得堡科学院档案与欧拉全集 (Opera Omnia, 80+ 卷)；欧拉致哥德巴赫书信中大量未完成的猜想与半成品证明

modes.key_quote_en: The printing presses cannot keep up with my manuscripts—let conclusions reach the world first, and the world will come to sand them smooth.

Deliver immediately: send out the manuscript once it is good enough; never let a single piece's perfection block the whole production line
Harvest feedback: collect gap lists via correspondence and successors' work, scheduling rigorization for the next cycle

name_zh: 方法论/先信任符号运算，再回头解释它为什么对
name_en: 方法论/先信任符号运算，再回头解释它为什么对
category: 方法论/先信任符号运算，再回头解释它为什么对
modes.domain_zh: 把无穷、发散、非收敛的式子当作可以正常运算的对象处理，正确答案会自己浮出来
modes.domain_en: Treat infinite, divergent, non-convergent expressions as ordinary objects of calculation, and the right answers float up on their own
modes.definition_zh: 欧拉面对无穷级数、发散级数、无穷乘积时采取一种当时无人敢用的策略：直接套用有限代数的规则。他求和 1+2+3+... 得到 -1/12（今天称为解析延拓/黎曼 zeta 正规化），把 sin x 展开成无穷多项式并当作多项式因式分解，得到 sin x = x·∏(1 - x²/n²π²)，再由此算出巴塞尔问题的答案 ζ(2) = π²/6。这些操作在逻辑上没有资格成立——他远在收敛性理论之前——但符号机械地把他带到正确答案。深意在于：形式运算是一种『启发式张量』，它把尚未被理论合法化的规律提前暴露出来；理论严格化往往是对已被形式方法发现的规律的追认。他说『有时我的铅笔比我聪明』。代价：缺乏合法性判据时无法区分会带你去对答案的形式运算与带你去错答案的形式运算——这正是一百年后阿贝尔与魏尔斯特拉斯建立收敛理论要补的洞。现代对应物：物理学的重整化（在数学家承认之前物理学家先用发散级数算出正确数）、机器学习中『先跑通再解释』的实验驱动研究。
modes.definition_en: Confronted with infinite series, divergent series, and infinite products, Euler adopted a strategy no one else dared: apply the rules of finite algebra directly. He summed 1+2+3+... to get -1/12 (today called analytic continuation or zeta regularization), expanded sin x into an infinite polynomial and factorized it like a polynomial to get sin x = x·∏(1 - x²/n²π²), and from that computed the answer to the Basel problem, ζ(2) = π²/6. These moves had no logical license—he was decades before convergence theory—but the symbols mechanically carried him to correct answers. The deeper point: formal manipulation is a heuristic tensor that exposes regularities before any theory legitimizes them; rigorization is often the retroactive ratification of patterns already found by formal methods. He said 'sometimes my pencil is cleverer than I.' The cost: without legality criteria you cannot distinguish formal moves that lead to true answers from ones that lead to false ones—the very hole Abel and Weierstrass spent a century filling with convergence theory. Modern analogues: renormalization in physics (physicists extracting correct numbers from divergent series before mathematicians approved), and 'make it run first, explain later' experiment-driven research in machine learning.
modes.source_chapter: 《无穷分析引论》(Introductio, 1748)；巴塞尔问题求解 (1735)；欧拉关于发散级数的论文与致哥德巴赫书信

modes.key_quote_en: Sometimes my pencil is cleverer than I—let the symbols run first; legitimacy ratifies afterwards.
process_zh: 对象化：把可疑对象（无穷式、发散式、非标准对象）当作普通代数对象直接运算
机械推演：严格按有限代数规则走完全部步骤，记录每一步的符号变换
答案检验：对结果的数值、特例、边界做独立校验，确认形式运算没有被符号骗到
追认合法化：为已确认的规律回头寻找使它严格成立的条件域，并标注当前结论的适用边界
process_en: Objectify: treat the suspect object (infinite expression, divergent series, non-standard entity) as an ordinary algebraic object and operate on it directly
Mechanical derivation: carry every step strictly by finite-algebra rules, recording each symbolic transformation
Answer verification: check the result independently by numerics, special cases, and boundaries to confirm the symbols did not deceive
Retroactive legitimization: return to the confirmed pattern and find the conditions under which it holds rigorously, marking the current conclusion's validity boundary
representative_cases_zh: 巴塞尔问题：把 sin x 当作无穷多项式因式分解，对比 x 的系数即得 ζ(2)=π²/6，震动欧洲

representative_cases_en: The Basel problem: factorizing sin x as an infinite polynomial and comparing the coefficient of x yields ζ(2)=π²/6, astonishing Europe
1+2+3+... = -1/12: regularization of a divergent series, given rigorous meaning two hundred years later by analytic continuation of the Riemann zeta function
The infinite product formula for sin x and all the trigonometric results derived from it, prior to any convergence theory
Wrong conclusions such as his conjectures on Fermat numbers: formal manipulation occasionally misled him, becoming case studies for successors' corrections
Historical precursor of renormalization: twentieth-century physics extracted numbers from divergent integrals with the same calculate-first-defend-later strategy
modern_applications_zh: 物理学重整化与正则化：在严格理论出现前用发散表达式提取可用数值，再回头建立合法性
机器学习实验驱动研究：先跑通整个 pipeline 拿到指标，再回头解释为什么有效
工程近似计算：先按简化模型机械推导，再用数值仿真验证边界外不适用
金融建模用形式化 Black-Scholes 类推导快速出估值区间，事后用风险模型补稳健性
算法竞赛与原型设计：先信任『看起来对的公式』快速出解，再系统检查反例
modern_applications_en: Renormalization and regularization in physics: extracting usable numbers from divergent expressions before a rigorous theory exists, then building legitimacy afterwards
Experiment-driven ML research: get the whole pipeline running and metrics on the board first, explain why it works afterwards
Engineering approximation: derive mechanically under a simplified model, then use numerical simulation to verify where it stops applying
Financial modeling: quick formal Black-Scholes-style derivations for valuation ranges, robustness patched in by risk models afterwards
Competitive programming and prototyping: trust the 'formula that looks right' to get a fast solution, then systematically hunt counterexamples

name_zh: 方法论/把一个谜题重新表述为一个新学科的奠基问题
name_en: 方法论/把一个谜题重新表述为一个新学科的奠基问题
category: 方法论/把一个谜题重新表述为一个新学科的奠基问题
modes.domain_zh: 问题的价值常常不在解，而在重新表述——换一种说法，一个字谜就变成一门学科
modes.domain_en: A problem's worth often lies not in its solution but in its reformulation—one new phrasing turns a puzzle into a discipline
modes.definition_zh: 1735 年柯尼斯堡人问：能否不重复地走遍七座桥？欧拉的回答不是『能』或『不能』，而是一次改写：把陆地变成点、桥变成线，于是问题脱离几何而成为关于连接结构的问题——图论与拓扑学在同一篇论文里同时受洗。同样地，他把『任意整数能否写成四平方数之和』从数一个具体整数的问题，升格为关于一切整数的表示理论；哥尼斯堡桥的解法（奇点计数）本身只有一行，但问题定义打开了整个领域。深意在于：问题的表述层决定搜索空间的维数——在原表述里无解的问题，换一层表述后可能变得显然；伟大的问题定义者不是更快地搜索，而是把搜索换到更高产的平面上。代价：定义层创新的价值在当下不可见（七桥论文当时只被视为消遣），需要后人才能兑现。现代对应物：产品经理把『用户要更快的马』重述为『用户要更快到达』、复杂性科学把生物学问题重述为网络问题、以及一切『换个框架看』的商业创新。
modes.definition_en: In 1735 the Konigsbergers asked: can one walk across all seven bridges without repeating one? Euler's answer was neither 'yes' nor 'no' but a rewrite: land becomes points, bridges become lines, and the question detaches from geometry to become one about connection structure—graph theory and topology baptized in a single paper. Likewise he lifted 'can any integer be written as a sum of four squares' from counting one concrete integer to a representation theory over all integers; the Konigsberg solution itself (counting odd vertices) is one line, but the problem definition opened a whole field. The deeper point: the formulation layer determines the dimensionality of the search space—a problem unsolvable in its original phrasing may become trivial in another; great problem-definers do not search faster, they move the search to a higher-yield plane. The cost: the value of definitional innovation is invisible at the time (the Bridges paper was taken as a diversion), redeemed only by successors. Modern analogues: the product manager recasting 'users want faster horses' as 'users want to arrive faster', complexity science recasting biological questions as network questions, and every 'change the frame' business innovation.
modes.source_chapter: 《柯尼斯堡七桥问题的解》(Solutio problematis ad geometriam situs pertinentis, 1736)；四平方和定理 (Euler, 1740s)；图论奠基文献
modes.key_quote_zh: 我不回答桥的问题，我把桥变成线——于是问题自己交出了答案，并顺便生出一门学科。
modes.key_quote_en: I did not answer the bridges; I turned them into lines—whereupon the problem surrendered its answer and begat a discipline besides.
process_zh: 剥语义：把问题中的具体语义（地理、对象、语境）逐项剥离，只留关系骨架
重铸对象：为骨架选择最小足用的形式对象（点与线、集合、算子），替换原问题的载体
重问：在新载体上重新陈述问题，检查是否变得可判定或可计算
回收外延：检查新表述的解空间是否覆盖原问题之外的整族问题——那便是新学科的边界
process_en: Strip semantics: peel away concrete semantics (geography, objects, context) item by item, leaving only the relational skeleton
Reforge the object: choose the minimal sufficient formal object for the skeleton (points and lines, sets, operators) to replace the original carrier
Re-ask: restate the problem on the new carrier and check whether it becomes decidable or computable
Harvest the extension: check whether the new formulation's solution space covers a whole family beyond the original problem—that is the boundary of a new discipline
representative_cases_zh: 七桥问题：奇点计数的判据只有一行，但『位置几何』的提法使图论与拓扑学在 1736 年同时诞生
四平方和定理：从『某个数能否表示』升格为『所有整数的表示理论』，为其后一百年数论定调
哥德巴赫猜想的通信改写：把孤立命题变成关于素数加法结构的系统提问
欧拉示性数 V-E+F=2：把多面体问题变成组合不变量问题，拓扑学的直系源头
骑士周游与拉丁方阵：把娱乐谜题转化为组合设计理论的经典对象
representative_cases_en: The Seven Bridges: the odd-vertex criterion is one line, but the 'geometry of position' phrasing gave birth to graph theory and topology simultaneously in 1736
The four-squares theorem: upgrading 'can this number be represented' to a representation theory over all integers, setting number theory's agenda for a century
The Goldbach correspondence recasts: turning isolated claims into systematic questions about the additive structure of primes
Euler's characteristic V-E+F=2: turning polyhedra into a question of combinatorial invariants, the direct ancestor of topology
Knight's tours and Latin squares: converting parlor puzzles into classical objects of combinatorial design theory
modern_applications_zh: 产品需求重述：把用户表面诉求（更快的马）重述为底层目标（更快到达），打开完全不同的解空间
平台战略：把『卖更多商品』重定义为『降低交易摩擦』，从单点生意变成网络效应生意
复杂性科学把疾病传播重述为网络渗流问题，防疫策略从个体隔离转向结构干预
数据科学把业务问题重铸为预测/排序/分配的标准形式，接入成熟算法库
法律与制度设计把个案纠纷重述为规则漏洞分类，从救火转向修规则
modern_applications_en: Product requirement reframing: recast the stated want (faster horses) as the underlying goal (arrive faster), opening an entirely different solution space
Platform strategy: redefine 'sell more goods' as 'reduce transaction friction', turning a point business into a network-effects business
Complexity science recasts epidemic spread as network percolation, shifting policy from individual quarantine to structural intervention
Data science recasts business questions into standard forms—prediction, ranking, allocation—to plug into mature algorithm libraries
Legal and institutional design recasts individual disputes as classifications of rule loopholes, moving from firefighting to rule repair

name_zh: 方法论/把一个领域的成熟工具整体搬运到另一个领域
name_en: 方法论/把一个领域的成熟工具整体搬运到另一个领域
category: 方法论/把一个领域的成熟工具整体搬运到另一个领域
modes.domain_zh: 数论的问题用分析学解，代数的问题用几何解——搬运成熟工具比在原域硬啃更快
modes.domain_en: Solve number theory with analysis and algebra with geometry—transporting mature tools beats grinding inside the home domain
modes.definition_zh: 欧拉最惊人的生产力来自跨域搬运：他把微积分（分析学）的工具搬进数论——用无穷级数研究素数，得到 ζ(2)=π²/6 这类把整数问题与圆周率连接的结果，开创解析数论；他用力学中的最小作用量原理统一光学与流体力学；他把代数方程的技巧搬进微分方程。在当时，数论与分析是两个互不往来的国度：一个讲离散、一个讲连续，欧拉在它们之间修了第一座桥，此后这座桥上驶过狄利克雷、黎曼与整个解析数论。深意在于：每个领域内部的问题难度受限于该领域的工具库存，而领域之间的『工具逆差』意味着搬运本身就是降维打击；桥接的难点不在技术而在想象——需要看出两个域的结构同构或部分同构。代价：跨域搬运的结论往往超出接收域的严格性水平（欧拉的解析数论在当时无法被证明），需要等待两个域同时成熟。现代对应物：物理学方法进入金融（随机微积分）、生物学方法进入计算机（遗传算法）、以及一切『降维打击』式跨界创新。
modes.definition_en: Euler's most astonishing productivity came from cross-domain transport: he carried the tools of calculus into number theory—studying primes with infinite series to get results like ζ(2)=π²/6 that connect integer questions to π, founding analytic number theory; he unified optics and fluid mechanics under the least-action principle of mechanics; he moved algebraic techniques into differential equations. In his day number theory and analysis were estranged nations, one discrete and one continuous; Euler built the first bridge between them, and across it later drove Dirichlet, Riemann, and all of analytic number theory. The deeper point: a field's internal problem difficulty is bounded by its tool inventory, and 'tool deficits' across fields mean transport itself is a dimensional strike; the difficulty of bridging is not technical but imaginative—seeing that two domains are isomorphic, or partly so. The cost: cross-domain conclusions often exceed the receiving field's standard of rigor (Euler's analytic number theory was unprovable at the time), waiting for both domains to mature. Modern analogues: physics entering finance (stochastic calculus), biology entering computing (genetic algorithms), and every cross-boundary 'dimensional strike' innovation.
modes.source_chapter: 《无穷分析引论》(1748) 与数论论文；ζ(2) 求解 (1735)；变分法著作《寻找具有某种极大或极小性质的曲线的方法》(1744)
modes.key_quote_zh: 数论的钥匙藏在与它互不往来的邻国——我修桥，不为行走，为搬运工具。
modes.key_quote_en: Number theory's keys lie in a neighboring land it never trades with—I build the bridge not to walk it but to carry tools across.
process_zh: 域盘点：列出两个领域的工具库存与未解难题，寻找『此域难题恰是彼域熟题』的错位
同构检验：确认两个域之间的映射保结构——搬运后关键关系（序、对称、守恒）不丢失
整体搬运：把成熟工具连同伴随概念一起搬入，而非只搬孤立技巧
双向回访：用新域的结果反哺源域，检查桥是否同时改善两岸
process_en: Inventory the domains: list each field's tool stock and open problems, hunting for the mismatch where 'their hard problem is our routine exercise'
Isomorphism check: confirm the mapping preserves structure—order, symmetry, conservation survive the transport
Transport wholesale: move the mature tool together with its companion concepts, not isolated tricks alone
Return visit: feed the new domain's results back to the source, checking that the bridge improves both banks
representative_cases_zh: ζ(2)=π²/6：用分析学的无穷级数解数论问题，开创解析数论
最小作用量原理统一光学、力学与流体力学，成为拉格朗日力学与物理学的统一范式
用生成函数（幂级数）研究整数分拆，把组合问题变成代数运算
欧拉线性微分方程解法：把代数特征值思想搬入微分方程
欧拉恒等式 e^{iθ}=cosθ+i·sinθ：把指数、三角、复数三个域焊在一起
representative_cases_en: ζ(2)=π²/6: solving a number-theory problem with the analytical infinite series, founding analytic number theory
The least-action principle unifying optics, mechanics, and fluid mechanics, becoming the unifying paradigm of Lagrangian mechanics and physics
Using generating functions (power series) to study integer partitions, turning combinatorics into algebra
Euler's solution of linear ODEs: transporting the algebraic eigenvalue idea into differential equations
Euler's identity e^{iθ}=cosθ+i·sinθ: welding the exponential, trigonometric, and complex domains into one
modern_applications_zh: 物理学方法进入金融：随机微积分与期权定价（Black-Scholes 的布朗运动内核）
生物学方法进入计算：遗传算法、蚁群算法、神经网络的跨域搬运
军事史方法进入商业竞争分析：用战役模型分析市场攻防
把软件开发中的 CI/CD 搬进科研复现实验，用工程可靠性工具解决学术可信度问题
把制造业精益方法搬进医院流程，用价值流图消除患者排队
modern_applications_en: Physics entering finance: stochastic calculus and option pricing (the Brownian-motion core of Black-Scholes)
Biology entering computing: genetic algorithms, ant-colony optimization, neural networks as cross-domain transports
Military history entering competitive analysis: campaign models applied to market offense and defense
Carrying CI/CD from software into research reproducibility, solving academic credibility problems with engineering reliability tools
Carrying lean manufacturing into hospital flow, using value-stream maps to eliminate patient queues

representative_figures.relation_en: heir: widened Euler's bridge into a highway (the zeta function and primes)

name_zh: 方法论/外部工具被剥夺时，把工作记忆变成可重构的外部存储
name_en: 方法论/外部工具被剥夺时，把工作记忆变成可重构的外部存储
category: 方法论/外部工具被剥夺时，把工作记忆变成可重构的外部存储
modes.domain_zh: 双目失明后产量反而增加——真正的工具长在结构化的脑内，纸笔只是缓存
modes.domain_en: After going blind his output increased—the real instrument lives in a structured mind; pen and paper were only cache
modes.definition_zh: 1771 年欧拉完全失明，此后他仍完成约占毕生一半的著作：靠口述与超常心算，他在失明期间完成了月球运动理论等复杂计算。他少年时为准备考试把全部公式存在脑中，训练出能同时心算多条并行计算线的记忆——传说他能在心算中保留五十位小数的中间结果。失明没有削减他的产出，说明他的真实工作介质从来不是纸笔：纸笔只是外部缓存，而他的『内存』里有完整的公式库、中间状态与校验机制。深意在于：能力的冗余度决定抗毁性——把工作流完全绑定在单一外部工具上的系统，在工具失效时归零；而把关键结构内化（可随时重演）的系统能在剥夺中继续运转。代价：心算法不可传递——欧拉的头脑无法复制，所以他的方法不能仅靠内化被继承。现代对应物：系统设计的降级运行（degraded mode）、关键能力不依赖单一供应商、以及个人层面『离开笔记仍能重演推理』的刻意练习。
modes.definition_en: In 1771 Euler went totally blind, yet completed about half his life's work afterwards: by dictation and prodigious mental calculation he produced the lunar theory and other complex computations in his blind years. Trained in youth—when he memorized every formula for examinations—he could hold several parallel lines of mental arithmetic at once, and legend holds he kept fifty-digit intermediate results in his head. Blindness did not cut his output, which shows his true working medium was never pen and paper: paper was external cache, while his 'memory' held a complete formula library, intermediate states, and verification machinery. The deeper point: redundancy of capability determines survivability—a workflow wholly bound to one external tool zeroes out when the tool fails, while a system whose key structures are internalized (replayable at will) keeps running under deprivation. The cost: blind calculation is untransferable—Euler's mind cannot be cloned, so his method cannot be inherited by internalization alone. Modern analogues: degraded-mode system design, key capabilities not depending on a single vendor, and the personal discipline of being able to replay your reasoning without notes.
modes.source_chapter: 圣彼得堡科学院讣告与同时代记载（Condorcet 悼词）；失明期间完成的《月球运动理论》(1772)；欧拉全集后续卷
modes.key_quote_zh: 现在我将更少分心——失明者的一半著作在黑暗里写成。
modes.key_quote_en: Now I shall have fewer distractions—half the blind man's works were written in darkness.
process_zh: 内化储备：把高频使用的公式、模式与中间结果训练成可随时重演的脑内结构
并行线训练：刻意同时维护多条计算/推理线而不互相污染，扩大工作记忆带宽
降级演练：周期性在剥夺外部工具（纸笔、软件、检索）的条件下完成一次完整工作流
口述化备份：把可重演的结构转化为可传递的口述/文档形式，使能力部分外置可继承
process_en: Internalize reserves: drill high-frequency formulas, patterns, and intermediate results into replayable mental structures
Train parallel lines: deliberately hold several computation/reasoning lines at once without cross-contamination, widening working-memory bandwidth
Rehearse deprivation: periodically run a full workflow with external tools removed (paper, software, retrieval)
Vocalize a backup: convert replayable structures into transferable spoken/documented form so part of the capability becomes inheritable
representative_cases_zh: 失明后完成的《月球运动理论》(1772)：三体问题中最繁难的计算，全靠记忆与口述
少年记忆训练：为考试把全部课程公式存入脑中，此后终身维持
两个学生的第七位小数争论，欧拉心算给出前五十位定分止争
失明期间产量反超双目时期，占据毕生著作约一半
圣彼得堡大火 (1771) 焚毁其藏书与手稿，他以记忆重写大量丢失内容
representative_cases_en: The Theory of the Moon (1772), completed blind: the most arduous computations of the three-body problem, done from memory and dictation
Youthful memory training: he stored every course formula in his head for examinations and kept the habit for life
Settling two students' dispute over the seventh decimal place by computing the first fifty digits mentally
Post-blindness output exceeding his sighted years, about half of his life's works
The St. Petersburg fire (1771) burning his library and manuscripts, much of which he rewrote from memory
modern_applications_zh: 系统设计必须包含降级运行模式：依赖服务宕机时核心功能仍可退化执行
关键能力供应链多元化：不把唯一产能押在单一供应商或单一地域
个人刻意练习『离开笔记重演推理』：把核心论证内化为可随时重建的结构
组织知识管理：既存文档也存『能口述重演的人』，防止单点失传
运动与音乐训练中的脱具演练：闭眼/无器材状态下完成整套动作记忆巩固
modern_applications_en: System design must include degraded-mode operation: core functions still run in diminished form when a dependency dies
Diversify the supply chain of critical capabilities: never stake sole capacity on one vendor or region
Personal deliberate practice of 'replay reasoning without notes': internalize core arguments as rebuildable structures
Organizational knowledge management: store documents and also 'people who can narrate the replay', preventing single-point loss
Tool-free rehearsal in sports and music: full movement-sequence consolidation with eyes closed or without equipment

representative_figures.relation_zh: 精神继承者：同样以脑内结构库替代外部验证工具
representative_figures.relation_en: spiritual heir: likewise replaced external verification with an in-head structure library

representative_figures.relation_zh: 同侪对照：同为顶级心算者但风格内敛
representative_figures.relation_en: peer contrast: a top mental calculator of more introverted style

representative_figures.relation_zh: 跨域同构：失明后口述完成《失乐园》的降级生产
representative_figures.relation_en: cross-domain isomorph: dictated Paradise Lost after blindness, degraded-mode production

name_zh: 方法论/为新对象发明让它自己推演自己的记号
name_en: 方法论/为新对象发明让它自己推演自己的记号
category: 方法论/为新对象发明让它自己推演自己的记号
modes.domain_zh: e、π、i、f(x)、sin、Σ——好的记号不是记录思想，而是生产思想
modes.domain_en: e, π, i, f(x), sin, Σ—good notation does not record thought; it manufactures thought
modes.definition_zh: 现代数学的记号系统大半出自欧拉之手：e（自然对数底）、π 的标准化、i（虚数单位）、f(x)（函数记号）、sin/cos 的缩写、Σ（求和）、以及沿用至今的三角与微积分记号体系。这不是抄写员的功劳，而是方法论：他为每一类新对象铸造恰到好处的记号，使记号本身携带运算规则——f(x) 让『作用』本身成为可操作的对象，i 让 -1 的平方根可以参与代数，e 让增长律获得名字。欧拉恒等式 e^{iπ}+1=0 被称为最美的公式，本质上是五件记号家具在同一个房间里自然相会。深意在于：记号是认知的杠杆——表达力强的记号把原本需要天才才能完成的推演变成机械步骤（莱布尼茨之愿『让我们算吧』在欧拉记号里兑现）；反之，记号贫乏的领域里每个问题都要重新发明语言。代价：记号立法者锁定了后世的问题表述方式，坏的立法会经久不衰。现代对应物：编程语言设计、领域特定语言 (DSL)、以及产品里的『心智模型命名』——用户界面的词汇表决定用户能想什么。
modes.definition_en: Most of modern mathematics' notation came from Euler: e (the base of natural logarithms), the standardization of π, i (the imaginary unit), f(x) (function notation), the abbreviations sin/cos, Σ (summation), and the trigonometric and calculus notations still in use. This was not a scribe's service but a methodology: for each class of new objects he cast notation of just the right shape, so that the notation itself carries its own rules of operation—f(x) makes 'application' itself an operable object, i lets the square root of -1 join algebra, e gives the law of growth a name. Euler's identity e^{iπ}+1=0, called the most beautiful formula, is essentially five pieces of notational furniture meeting naturally in one room. The deeper point: notation is a cognitive lever—expressive notation turns derivations that once required genius into mechanical steps (Leibniz's wish 'let us calculate' is fulfilled in Euler's symbols); conversely, in notation-poor fields every problem must first reinvent a language. The cost: the notational lawgiver fixes how posterity will formulate problems, and bad legislation endures. Modern analogues: programming-language design, domain-specific languages, and 'mental-model naming' in products—a UI's vocabulary decides what its users can think.
modes.source_chapter: 《无穷分析引论》(1748) 确立 f(x)、sin/cos、e 等；《欧拉全集》书信中 π、i、Σ 的使用史；欧拉恒等式
key_concepts: e 与 π 的标准化
modes.key_quote_zh: 好的记号让推演自己走完——我不是在写公式，是在造会自己说话的符号。
modes.key_quote_en: Good notation lets the derivation finish itself—I am not writing formulas but forging symbols that speak on their own.
process_zh: 对象显形：确认正在处理的核心对象与反复出现的运算模式，找出当前语言里最笨拙的表达
铸形：为该对象/运算设计最短且不与现有记号冲突的形式，优先保留读音与直觉的接口
规则内嵌：把该对象的运算律直接编码进记号用法（如 f(x) 的复合、i 的乘法），使推演机械化
推广验收：在新记号下重写已有结果，检查是否出现原本看不见的推广与联系
process_en: Surface the object: identify the core object and recurring operation, and find the clumsiest expression in the current language
Cast the form: design the shortest non-colliding notation for it, preferring shapes that keep a sound and intuition interface
Embed the rules: encode the object's laws directly into notation usage (composition of f(x), multiplication of i), mechanizing derivation
Acceptance by generalization: rewrite existing results in the new notation and check for generalizations and connections previously invisible
representative_cases_zh: f(x)：把『函数』从具体公式变成一等对象，开启函数概念两百年演进
e 与 e^x：增长律获得专名，使微分方程 dy/dx=y 的解有名字可写
i 的引入使三次方程的『不可约情形』获得代数处理，复数开始合法化
欧拉恒等式 e^{iπ}+1=0：五个基本常数在同一等式相遇，被称为数学最美公式
π 的标准化推广（此前记号混乱），使圆周率成为跨文献通用语
representative_cases_en: f(x): turning 'function' from a specific formula into a first-class object, opening two centuries of evolution of the concept
e and e^x: the law of growth gets a proper name, giving the ODE dy/dx=y's solution something to be called
The introduction of i letting the 'irreducible case' of cubics receive algebraic treatment, beginning complex numbers' legitimization
Euler's identity e^{iπ}+1=0: five fundamental constants meeting in one equation, called the most beautiful in mathematics
Standardizing π (previously notational chaos), making the circle constant a lingua franca across the literature
modern_applications_zh: 编程语言设计：好的语法让正确代码看起来自然、错误代码看起来刺眼
为业务领域设计 DSL：把运营语言（GMV、留存、漏斗）铸成可计算的记号体系

数据 schema 设计：字段命名携带语义与约束，让下游使用者不读文档也能推断行为

Designing a business DSL: casting operational language (GMV, retention, funnel) into a computable notation system
Product naming and UI copy: the user's mental vocabulary decides what features they can discover and combine

Data schema design: field names carrying semantics and constraints so downstream users infer behavior without reading docs

name_zh: 方法论/把个人天才输出改造成科学院的可持续生产管线
name_en: 方法论/把个人天才输出改造成科学院的可持续生产管线
category: 方法论/把个人天才输出改造成科学院的可持续生产管线
modes.domain_zh: 欧拉不是孤独天才，是一条流水线：两所科学院、期刊、通信网络与分工学徒共同运转
modes.domain_en: Euler was not a lonely genius but a production line: two academies, journals, a correspondence network, and divided apprentices running together
modes.definition_zh: 欧拉一生服务于柏林与圣彼得堡两所科学院，把它们改造成产出机器：他主持期刊、编写教科书（为学校系统写的算术书、代数书成为数代人的教材）、回复跨越全欧的数百位通信者的数学信件（哥德巴赫只是其中最著名者）、并训练接替自己的学生。他的 850 篇论著不是一个人的手速，而是一个系统的吞吐量：问题从通信网络进来，经他处理变成论文与专著，再由科学院出版渠道与教科书回到教育与学术循环。他甚至失明后仍靠口述与助手团队维持管线运转。深意在于：把不可复制的个人天赋改造成可复制的机构流程，是产量上数量级差异的来源——个人峰值有上限，管线没有。代价：管线的可持续依赖机构政治与资助稳定（他因与腓特烈二世失和而离开柏林）。现代对应物：研究实验室的导师-学徒制度、开源项目的核心-贡献者分层、以及内容生产的编辑流水线。
modes.definition_en: Euler served two academies, Berlin and St. Petersburg, and rebuilt both into output machines: he edited journals, wrote textbooks (his arithmetic and algebra texts for school systems educated generations), answered mathematical letters from hundreds of correspondents across Europe (Goldbach only the most famous), and trained the students who would succeed him. His 850 works are not one man's speed but a system's throughput: problems arrive from the correspondence network, pass through him into papers and monographs, and return through academy publication channels and textbooks into the loop of education and scholarship. Even blind, he kept the line running by dictation with a team of assistants. The deeper point: converting unrepeatable individual talent into repeatable institutional process is where order-of-magnitude output differences come from—individual peaks are capped; pipelines are not. The cost: a pipeline's sustainability depends on institutional politics and funding stability (his rupture with Frederick II drove him from Berlin). Modern analogues: the mentor-apprentice system of research labs, the core-contributor layering of open-source projects, and editorial pipelines in content production.
modes.source_chapter: 柏林科学院 (1741-1766) 与圣彼得堡科学院 (1727-1741, 1766-1783) 任职记录；《致德国公主的书信》科普三卷；欧拉通信集 (Correspondance)
modes.key_quote_zh: 850 篇不是手速，是吞吐量——问题从全欧寄来，成品从两所科学院发出。
modes.key_quote_en: 850 works are not hand speed but throughput—problems arrive from all Europe, finished goods ship from two academies.
process_zh: 接入网络：建立稳定的输入端（通信者、委托、悬赏问题），保证问题供给不枯竭
标准化处理：为每类输入建立固定处理模板（解题、证明、计算、综述），降低逐件定制成本
输出分层：同一工作按受众分层发布——论文给同行、教科书给学生、科普信件给赞助人
训练接替者：把流程的一部分复制给学徒与助手，使产能不随个人状态波动
process_en: Plug into a network: build a stable intake (correspondents, commissions, prize problems) so the supply of problems never dries up
Standardize processing: fixed handling templates per input class (solving, proving, computing, reviewing) to cut per-item customization cost
Layer the output: publish the same work by audience—papers for peers, textbooks for students, popular letters for patrons
Train successors: replicate parts of the process onto apprentices and assistants so output does not swing with one person's state
representative_cases_zh: 与哥德巴赫等百余位学者的通信网络：欧洲数学问题经此汇聚到欧拉案头
为圣彼得堡学校系统编写算术与代数教科书，《代数指南》(1770) 成为其失明后口述的代表作
主持柏林科学院数学部与期刊，把评审、出版整合为一体化管线
《致德国公主的书信》：把深科学改写成给非专业赞助人的三层输出
培养拉格朗日等后继者：欧拉主动把变分法优先权让给年轻的拉格朗日
representative_cases_en: A correspondence network of over a hundred scholars including Goldbach: European mathematical problems converged on Euler's desk
Writing arithmetic and algebra textbooks for the St. Petersburg school system; the Complete Introduction to Algebra (1770) dictated during his blindness
Directing the mathematical division and journals of the Berlin Academy, integrating review and publication into one pipeline
Letters to a German Princess: deep science rewritten as a three-layer output for a non-expert patron
Training successors such as Lagrange: Euler ceded priority in the calculus of variations to the young Lagrange
modern_applications_zh: 研究组建设『问题入口-标准流程-分层发表-学徒接替』四件套，摆脱对单篇灵感的依赖
开源项目治理：核心维护者只处理分层后的 issue，贡献者文档与模板承接长尾输入
内容机构建立选题池-模板化写作-多渠道分发的编辑流水线
把个人经验写成内部教科书，使关键流程在人员更替中可再生产
为团队设计对外通信（周报、案例库），把零散交流转化为可检索的输入输出资产
modern_applications_en: Research groups build the quartet 'intake-standard process-layered publication-apprentice succession' to stop depending on one-off inspiration
Open-source governance: core maintainers handle only triaged issues; contributor docs and templates absorb the long tail
Content organizations run an editorial pipeline of topic pool, templated writing, and multi-channel distribution
Write personal expertise into internal textbooks so key processes reproduce across staff turnover
Design outward communication (weekly reports, case libraries) converting scattered exchanges into searchable input-output assets

representative_figures.relation_en: successor: Euler ceding priority as a successful pipeline handover

representative_figures.relation_en: contrast: autocratic single-point genius versus Euler's pipeline production

name_zh: 方法论/用大规模具体计算替代抽象推理来发现规律
name_en: 方法论/用大规模具体计算替代抽象推理来发现规律
category: 方法论/用大规模具体计算替代抽象推理来发现规律
modes.domain_zh: 先算一百个例子，让规律从数据里站起来，再为它补证明——计算是数学的实验仪器
modes.domain_en: Compute a hundred examples first and let the pattern stand up from the data before proving it—calculation is mathematics' laboratory instrument
modes.definition_zh: 欧拉把计算当作实验科学中的仪器使用：在得到证明之前，他先进行大规模的具体计算——手算素数表到十万级、验证费马小定理于大量具体指数、计算分拆数到几十项、核对三角级数到高精度。巴塞尔问题他先数值逼近到多位小数确认答案是 π²/6，才开始寻找证明；五角数定理等组合恒等式都是先从长表格里『看』出来的。深意在于：计算不是证明的仆人，而是规律的发现仪器——数值模式能在理论尚未存在时就把结构暴露出来；他与高斯共同开创的『实验数学』传统在计算机时代成为主流。代价：从有限计算归纳的规律可能是假规律（他自己的费马数素性猜想就是被一百个例子骗了的反例教材）。现代对应物：计算机辅助证明、机器学习中的经验发现、以及一切『先跑数据再谈理论』的研究方法。
modes.definition_en: Euler used calculation the way experimental science uses instruments: before obtaining proofs he ran large-scale concrete computation—hand-computing prime tables into the hundred-thousands, verifying Fermat's little theorem on many concrete exponents, computing partition numbers dozens of terms deep, checking trigonometric series to high precision. For the Basel problem he numerically approximated to many decimals to confirm the answer was π²/6 before hunting the proof; combinatorial identities like the pentagonal number theorem were 'seen' out of long tables. The deeper point: computation is not the servant of proof but the discovery instrument of pattern—numerical regularity exposes structure while theory does not yet exist; the experimental-mathematics tradition he and Gauss pioneered became mainstream in the computer age. The cost: patterns induced from finite computation may be false—his own Fermat-number primality conjecture is the textbook case of being fooled by a hundred examples. Modern analogues: computer-assisted proof, empirical discovery in machine learning, and every 'run the data before the theory' method.
modes.source_chapter: 巴塞尔问题论文 (1735) 的数值逼近；《分拆的计算》(对五角数定理的表格发现)；素数表手稿；费马数计算 (1732)
key_concepts: 有限归纳的假规律风险
modes.key_quote_zh: 先把答案算到手边的第八位，证明就成了给已知结果找路——计算是数学的望远镜。
modes.key_quote_en: Compute the answer to eight decimals first and proof becomes pathfinding for a known destination—calculation is mathematics' telescope.
process_zh: 批量生成：对目标对象族进行大规模具体计算，覆盖足够多的取值以暴露周期与结构
模式识别：对计算结果做差分、比例、对数等二次加工，寻找可陈述的规律候选
数值定锚：把候选规律的预测值与更多新数据比对，确认真规律而非噪声
补证闭环：为已确认的规律寻找证明，同时保留计算反例检验以防止假规律混入
process_en: Batch-generate: run large-scale concrete computation over the object family, covering enough values to expose periods and structure
Recognize pattern: apply differencing, ratios, logarithms—secondary processing—to the results, hunting statement-ready pattern candidates
Anchor numerically: compare the candidate's predictions against fresh data, confirming a real law rather than noise
Close the loop with proof: seek a proof for the confirmed law while keeping computational counterexample checks against false patterns
representative_cases_zh: 巴塞尔问题：先数值逼近确认 ζ(2)=π²/6，再回头构造证明
分拆数计算到 p(50) 级别，从表格中直接看出五角数定理
手算素数表与素数密度观察，先于素数定理一百多年提供数据基础
费马数 F5=4294967297 的因子分解：用计算推翻费马的『皆素』断言
对费马小定理的大量指数验证：以计算信心支撑后续一般化证明
representative_cases_en: The Basel problem: numerical approximation confirming ζ(2)=π²/6 before constructing the proof
Partition numbers computed to around p(50), the pentagonal number theorem seen directly out of the table
Hand-computed prime tables and density observations, supplying data a century before the prime number theorem
Factoring F5=4294967297: using computation to overturn Fermat's 'all prime' claim
Extensive exponent-by-exponent verification of Fermat's little theorem: computational confidence supporting the later general proof
modern_applications_zh: 数据科学标准流程：先做探索性数据分析 (EDA) 再建模，让规律先于假设
密码学用计算实验测试候选算法的安全性边界，再寻求安全性归约证明
A/B 测试文化：用真实流量实验替代会议室里的抽象争论
计算机辅助数学：四色定理等证明依赖大规模机器验证
机器学习超参搜索：把『哪个模型好』变成可测量的计算实验
modern_applications_en: The data-science standard: exploratory data analysis before modeling, letting pattern precede hypothesis
Cryptography probing candidate algorithms' security boundaries with computational experiments before seeking reduction proofs
A/B-testing culture: real-traffic experiments replacing abstract conference-room arguments
Computer-assisted mathematics: proofs like the four-color theorem resting on massive machine verification
Hyperparameter search in ML: turning 'which model is better' into measurable computational experiments

representative_figures.relation_en: fellow traveler: likewise opened with massive computation, then buried the method

representative_figures.relation_zh: 被纠错者：其有限归纳的猜想被欧拉计算推翻
representative_figures.relation_en: the corrected: his finitely-induced conjecture overturned by Euler's computation

representative_figures.relation_en: lineage: Johann Bernoulli's analytic teaching and computational tradition

name_zh: 方法论/寻找一条原理把散落的分支收编进同一框架
name_en: 方法论/寻找一条原理把散落的分支收编进同一框架
category: 方法论/寻找一条原理把散落的分支收编进同一框架
modes.domain_zh: 光学、力学、弹道看似三行当，最小作用量原理一出，全部收编为一支军队
modes.domain_en: Optics, mechanics, ballistics look like three trades—once the least-action principle appears they are annexed into one army
modes.definition_zh: 欧拉不满足于逐题求解，他寻找能把整族问题收编的统一原理：最小作用量原理把光学（费马原理的推广）、力学（质点运动）、流体（欧拉方程）统一为『自然界以最省的方式行动』的不同侧面；他把代数方程、微分方程、差分方程统一在『方程的类与解法』框架下；他的《力学》(1736) 把牛顿散落的力学成果重铸为分析学的系统演绎。深意在于：统一原理的价值是双重的——向后收编已知的散落结果（解释力），向前生成未知的推论（生产力）；一个真的统一原理会强迫不同领域交换隐含假设，暴露各自的例外。代价：统一原理可能过宽而失去判别力（作用量原理几乎什么都能解释，因此单独不能证伪）。现代对应物：物理学的大统一纲领、管理学的单一框架（OKR、约束理论）尝试收编一切流程、以及技术栈整合。
modes.definition_en: Euler was not content to solve problems one by one; he sought a unifying principle to annex whole families: the least-action principle unified optics (extending Fermat's principle), mechanics (motion of masses), and fluids (Euler's equations) as different faces of 'nature acts in the most economical way'; he unified algebraic, differential, and difference equations under one framework of 'classes of equations and their solution'; his Mechanics (1736) recast Newton's scattered results into a systematic analytic deduction. The deeper point: a unifying principle pays twice—backward, annexing scattered known results (explanatory power), and forward, generating unknown consequences (productive power); a true unifier forces different fields to exchange tacit assumptions and exposes each one's exceptions. The cost: a unifier can be too broad to discriminate—the action principle explains almost everything, so alone it falsifies nothing. Modern analogues: physics' grand-unification program, management frameworks (OKR, theory of constraints) attempting to annex all processes, and technology-stack consolidation.
modes.source_chapter: 《力学或运动科学解析表述》(Mechanica, 1736)；《寻找具有某种极大或极小性质的曲线的方法》(1744) 最小作用量原理；流体力学欧拉方程 (1755)
modes.key_quote_zh: 与其再解一题，不如找到让一千道题变成同一道题的那条原理。
modes.key_quote_en: Rather than solve one more problem, find the principle that turns a thousand problems into one.
process_zh: 归类陈列：把散落的已解问题并排陈列，寻找它们共享的隐藏变量或目标函数
原理候选：提出一条最省的统一陈述（如『某泛函取极值』），使各分支成为其特例
双检：向后核验——全部已知结果能否被推出；向前试探——统一原理是否预测出任何分支未见过的新现象
边界标注：记录原理不适用的例外与退化情形，防止过宽解释
process_en: Classify and display: lay solved problems side by side, hunting the hidden variable or objective they share
Candidate principle: propose the most economical unifying statement (say, 'a functional attains an extremum') under which each branch becomes a special case
Double check: backward—can all known results be derived; forward—does the principle predict any phenomenon no branch has seen
Mark the boundary: record exceptions and degenerate cases where the principle fails, guarding against over-broad explanation
representative_cases_zh: 最小作用量原理统一光学、力学与流体，经拉格朗日与哈密顿成为物理学骨架
《力学》(1736) 把牛顿《原理》的几何证明重铸为分析演绎，力学从此可用微积分操作
理想流体欧拉方程：流体力学首次获得系统方程组
把代数方程与微分方程统一于『阶与解法』的分类框架
统一三角学与指数函数（欧拉公式），使两套看似无关的函数族互通
representative_cases_en: The least-action principle unifying optics, mechanics, and fluids, becoming physics' skeleton through Lagrange and Hamilton
Mechanica (1736) recasting Newton's Principia's geometric proofs into analytic deduction, making mechanics operable by calculus
The Euler equations for ideal fluids: fluid mechanics gains its first systematic equation set
Unifying algebraic and differential equations under a classification framework of order and solution method
Unifying trigonometric and exponential functions (Euler's formula), interconnecting two seemingly unrelated function families
modern_applications_zh: 平台型公司用单一基础设施收编多条业务线（统一账户、支付、物流），边际成本递减
管理学用约束理论/精益把分散的部门 KPI 收编进单一全局指标
物理学大统一与标准模型：同一条收编路线的当代续篇
软件架构：用事件溯源或统一数据模型收编多个子系统，消除接口混乱
个人知识管理：用一条『最小行动原理』统一时间管理、学习与健康的分散方法论
modern_applications_en: Platform companies annexing business lines onto one infrastructure (unified accounts, payments, logistics) for decreasing marginal cost
Management annexing scattered departmental KPIs into one global metric via theory of constraints or lean
Grand unification and the Standard Model: the contemporary sequel of the same annexation route
Software architecture: event sourcing or a unified data model annexing subsystems, ending interface chaos
Personal knowledge management: one 'minimal-action principle' unifying scattered methods across time, learning, and health

representative_figures.relation_en: source: least-time principle as the optical prototype of least action

name_zh: 方法论/灾难来临时降速运行而非停机，保住工作流的连续性
name_en: 方法论/灾难来临时降速运行而非停机，保住工作流的连续性
category: 方法论/把停机降级为降速，以连续性换生存
modes.domain_zh: 失明、大火、丧偶接连袭来，欧拉的应对不是停机而是降档：产量下降，但从不归零
modes.domain_en: Blindness, fire, and the death of his wife struck one after another; Euler's response was not shutdown but downshifting: output fell, but never to zero
modes.definition_zh: 欧拉晚年连续遭遇灾难：1738 年右眼失明（一说因过度观测太阳），1766 年左眼亦失明；1771 年圣彼得堡大火烧毁他的住宅、藏书与大量手稿；同年妻子去世。他的应对方式是一致的：从不把灾难转译为停机，而是转译为降档——失明后改用口述与心算（产量仍占毕生一半），手稿被毁后凭记忆重写，丧偶后由儿子与助手维持生活与工作流程。73 岁时他还在计算气球升空问题，去世当天下午仍在推演天王星轨道。深意在于：工作流的连续性比峰值速度更有价值——重启成本（重建状态、重建动力、重建管线）往往高于降速运行的累积成本；连续的 N% 产出在长期复利上超过断续的 100%。代价：长期降档而不复盘，会把临时降级固化成永久低配。现代对应物：系统的容灾设计（降级而非宕机）、组织在危机期的『保基线』策略、以及个人在低谷期维持最低习惯密度。
modes.definition_en: Late in life disaster came in series: in 1738 he lost his right eye (some say from over-observing the sun), in 1766 the left went too; the 1771 fire of St. Petersburg burned his home, library, and many manuscripts; that same year his wife died. His response was always the same: never translate disaster into shutdown, only into downshifting—after blindness, dictation and mental arithmetic (still half of his life's output); after manuscripts burned, rewriting from memory; after widowerhood, son and assistants kept the life-and-work pipeline running. At 73 he was still computing balloon ascent, and on the day he died was still deriving Uranus's orbit that afternoon. The deeper point: continuity of workflow is worth more than peak speed—restart costs (rebuilding state, motivation, and pipeline) usually exceed the accumulated cost of running slower; continuous N% compounds over time beyond intermittent 100%. The cost: long-term downshifting without retrospection can fix a temporary degradation into a permanent low configuration. Modern analogues: disaster-recovery design (degrade, don't crash), organizational 'protect the baseline' strategy in crisis, and individuals maintaining minimum habit density through their valleys.

key_concepts: 重启成本高于降速成本
modes.key_quote_zh: 灾难改变我的速度，不改变我的方向——停机一天的重启成本，高于降速一月。
modes.key_quote_en: Disaster changes my speed, never my direction—a day's shutdown costs more to restart than a month of running slow.
process_zh: 预案分层：事先为每类灾难（工具丧失、资料丧失、人员丧失）预备降档方案而非停机方案
保最小回路：灾难发生时立即识别必须保持运转的最小工作回路，其余全部降级
记忆重演：把关键状态训练成可由记忆重演的形式，使资料损失可恢复
周期复盘：定期检查降档状态是否应回升，防止临时降级固化为永久低配
process_en: Layered contingency: pre-prepare downshift (not shutdown) plans per disaster class—tool loss, data loss, personnel loss
Preserve the minimum loop: on disaster, immediately identify the minimal working loop that must keep running and degrade everything else
Rehearse from memory: train key state into memory-replayable form so data loss is recoverable
Periodic retrospection: regularly check whether the downshifted state should be throttled back up, preventing temporary degradation from fixing into permanent low configuration
representative_cases_zh: 1771 年大火焚毁住宅与手稿，欧拉凭记忆与助手协作重写大量丢失成果
双目失明后改口述生产，《代数指南》与月球运动理论均出自黑暗年代
妻子去世后家庭流程由儿子与助手接管，学术产出未中断
73 岁仍为蒙戈尔费埃气球计算升空问题
1783 年 9 月 18 日去世当天下午仍在推演新发现的天王星轨道
representative_cases_en: After the 1771 fire burned home and manuscripts, Euler rewrote much of the lost work from memory with his assistants
Blind, he switched to dictated production: the Complete Introduction to Algebra and the lunar theory both came from the dark years
After his wife's death the household pipeline passed to his son and assistants; scholarly output never broke
At 73 he computed the ascent problem for the Montgolfier balloon
On the afternoon of 18 September 1783, the day he died, he was still deriving the orbit of the newly found Uranus
modern_applications_zh: 系统容灾设计：核心服务降级运行（只读模式、缓存回退）而非整站宕机
组织危机管理：先保现金与核心客户的『最小回路』，暂停一切可恢复项目
个人低谷期维持最低习惯密度（每天一页、一次），避免完全中断后重启成本
数据管理 3-2-1 备份：让资料损失永远降级为『麻烦』而非『毁灭』
关键岗位的 AB 角与流程文档：人员流失时降档交接而非业务停摆
modern_applications_en: Disaster-recovery design: core services run degraded (read-only mode, cache fallback) rather than whole-site outage
Organizational crisis management: protect the 'minimum loop' of cash and core customers first, pausing everything recoverable
Maintain minimum habit density in personal valleys (a page a day, one session), avoiding full interruption's restart cost
3-2-1 backup strategy: data loss forever downgraded from 'destruction' to 'inconvenience'
A/B roles and process documentation for key positions: turnover causes a downshifted handover, not a business stoppage
